title: acer campestre f. hederifolium
intro: Acer campestre f. hederifolium, commonly known as Field Maple, is a cultivar of the Field Maple tree (Acer campestre) that is prized for its distinctive, deeply lobed leaves resembling those of the Ivy Maple tree (Acer pensylvanicum). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to support digestive health, with potential benefits including relief from indigestion, bloating, and other gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Field Maple are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Field Maple may also contribute to its traditional uses in supporting immune function and reducing oxidative stress.
